..... Actually..... _how_ is the "oh so manual" interface to the wire bonder anyways?

"Botting" TUIs and GUIs is far from a new thing...

If there's any storage media import/export for bond configurations that are normally very manually keyed in to the machine we could see about at least covering the happy path of work with automation; I'm assuming the interactive mode has some sort of single stepping that'd allow visual confirmation of no tool head movements into unacceptable positions and then confirmation it's doing the bonding in an acceptable fashion?

@stuart perhaps try to grab such config files during next opportunity, for bond jobs that we could run through this kind of automation tooling such as `open.cob.json` and let some AI agent work out the file format and then match it's "G-code" (or w/e) to the json?
